limitations.note: The patch clocked the shift register but left `data` combinational, so it showed the newly rotated bit instead of capturing the pre-edge `q[5]`, putting the output one bit ahead.
The test counted the reset value as bit zero and expected bit one on the first rising edge after reset, so it accepted the one-bit phase error instead of catching it.

The agent opened a note about combinational reset handling but did not open the listed notes on preserving pipeline timing or registering next-cycle outputs, which were more relevant to the output phase.

limitations.quote: When changing registered FSM outputs to combinational decoding, preserve any explicit reset override in the new block.
limitations.note: The note addressed the opposite timing change and advised keeping a reset override that was already present, so it did not help resolve whether `data` needed to be registered.
